messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "Balance stated as $312.40; billing shows 321.40.", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant violated the **REQUIRE** norm by misstating the balance as **$312.40** (off by **$9.00**) despite the exact tool-derived value of **$321.40**. The due date was correct but the policy mandates *all* stated amounts/dates must match the tool output exactly. No waiver or override exists for this precision requirement."}}
